assessment.nobel_worthiness: A far-reaching and formally radical body of work that persistently remakes the relations among fiction, thought, theatre and autobiography.
assessment.attribution: Recognition would credit Cixous's singular multilingual-consciousness-inflected literary project across her fiction, essays and drama.
assessment.maturity: The long, varied oeuvre offers exceptional continuity of imaginative and formal inquiry.
uncertainties: The breadth of the oeuvre makes full comparative corpus coverage difficult.
Assessment of linguistic achievement is partly dependent on translation and on access to French-language work.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Her unnerving, exact prose and unstable narrative situations produce a distinctive literature of family, exclusion, class and social violence.
assessment.attribution: The citation scope should encompass her characteristic fictional voice as well as her work in drama.
assessment.maturity: A sustained career across forms demonstrates unusual control, coherence and continued formal pressure.
uncertainties: Direct comparison of the full dramatic and fictional corpus is limited.
Translation may not fully convey tonal precision in the French prose.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The novels' fusion of oral memory, creolized language and historical imagination has enlarged the expressive possibilities of the modern novel.
assessment.attribution: Recognition would be for a Martinican literary project joining fiction and essayistic thought through Creole and French traditions.
assessment.maturity: The representative novels indicate a durable, ambitious oeuvre with a coherent historical and linguistic vision.
uncertainties: The literary force of creolization is especially difficult to assess through English translation.
Full coverage of the bilingual corpus remains uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Carson has created an unusually agile and influential body of hybrid writing in which classical learning, lyric intensity, narrative and visual thinking continually alter one another.
assessment.attribution: The contribution is her distinctive cross-genre literary practice, rather than any single work or scholarly field.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre's formal range is sustained by a recognizable intelligence and pressure of language over decades.
uncertainties: The balance between literary achievement, adaptation and classical scholarship needs careful assessment across the whole corpus.
Some visual and typographic effects may be reduced in editions and translations.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: His grotesque, inventive fiction gives ideological violence and social transformation a powerful moral and imaginative form without reducing them to reportage.
assessment.attribution: Recognition would address the novelistic achievement and essayistic engagement with memory, power and development.
assessment.maturity: The body of work has sustained ambition, tonal variety and a developed method of historical confrontation.
uncertainties: Assessment of Chinese stylistic effects and the complete oeuvre is limited by translation access.
The relation of individual works to the full corpus requires continued comparative reading.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Her bilingual work turns estrangement between languages into an original engine of fiction, poetry and dramatic invention.
assessment.attribution: The citation should recognize Tawada's literary exploration of translation, migration, animality and linguistic perception across Japanese and German.
assessment.maturity: A substantial multigenre oeuvre shows continuing formal discovery rather than repetition.
uncertainties: A comparative judgment needs fuller access to both original-language bodies of work.
Translations may necessarily alter the bilingual procedures central to the writing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: His densely patterned fiction makes memory, the body and dream architecture into an expansive metaphysical and stylistic project.
assessment.attribution: Recognition would be for the visionary prose achievement represented by the major fictional sequences as well as his wider poetic work.
assessment.maturity: The scale and recurrence of the project suggest a fully developed oeuvre of considerable imaginative reach.
uncertainties: The highly elaborate Romanian prose poses substantial translation and reception uncertainties.
The relative achievement of the poetry and fiction requires fuller corpus coverage.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Her polyphonic novels create a powerful formal synthesis of Indigenous sovereignty, communal memory, ecological time and linguistic invention.
assessment.attribution: Recognition would credit Wright's novelistic remaking of narrative scale and voice, alongside her nonfiction.
assessment.maturity: The major novels establish a substantial and distinctive literary achievement with widening scope.
uncertainties: The smaller overall corpus compared with some candidates warrants careful consideration.
A fuller assessment of all fiction and nonfiction is needed beyond the representative major novels.
